name: Level Set Water Representation
aliases: Level Set Method for Liquid Surface
definition: Using the level set method to represent the liquid surface as a signed distance field, where φ < 0 is water and φ ≥ 0 is air.
summary: Level Set Water Representation tracks liquid surfaces in 3D grids using signed distance fields, preserving continuous distance data for accurate normals and topological flexibility unlike binary voxelization.
